seasonal_guards: Regional coastal seasonal reversal does not imply offshore Portugal reverses.
Drifter sampling was irregular and biased toward fall/winter near the coast; no monthly geometry inferred.
Regional source month windows cannot become twelve observed monthly frames.
Scenario envelope reflects selected endpoints and route choices, not annual extrema or confidence.
